cs.t: Standing desk with same USB C dock + jabra headset + ergonomic microsoft sculpt keyboard + similar dual monitors in my home and work office.  It's been very convenient as I can grab and go to plug in my personal laptop, work laptop, or usb c the peripherals to to the gaming desktop pretty easily. Dragon medical dictation and now dragon one dictation. I don't agree with their frankly predatory end of life discontinuation to not activate any more licenses for the former, but man is it convenient. Just gives my hands and mind a break. If you have suggestions for another ergonomic keyboard I'm all ears!  My work one stopped working with my corporate laptop this week and I can't figure it out.  Most of what I've seen doesn't have F-keys which are essential for me.
cs.th: Ask HN: What work/office purchase transformed your life?
